H3034: physically, to throw (a stone, an arrow) at or away; especially to revere or worship (with extended hands); intensively, to bemoan (by wringing the hands)
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H2896: good (as an adjective) in the widest sense; used likewise as a noun, both in the masculine and the feminine, the singular and the plural (good, a good or good thing, a good man or woman; the good, goods or good things, good men or women), also as an adverb (well)
H5769: properly, concealed, i.e. the vanishing point; generally, time out of mind (past or future), i.e. (practically) eternity; frequentatively, adverbial (especially with prepositional prefix) always
H2617: kindness; by implication (towards God) piety; rarely (by opposition) reproof, or (subject.) beauty
H430: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
H6213: to do or make, in the broadest sense and widest application
H6381: properly, perhaps to separate, i.e. distinguish (literally or figuratively); by implication, to be (causatively, make) great, difficult, wonderful
H1419: great (in any sense); hence, older; also insolent
H905: properly, separation; by implication, a part of the body, branch of atree, bar forcarrying; figuratively, chief of a city; especially (with prepositional prefix) as an adverb, apart, only, besides
H8064: the sky (as aloft; the dual perhaps alluding to the visible arch in which the clouds move, as well as to the higher ether where the celestial bodies revolve)
H8394: intelligence; by implication, an argument; by extension, caprice
H7554: to pound the earth (as a sign of passion); by analogy to expand (by hammering); by implication, to overlay (with thin sheets of metal)
H776: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H4325: water; figuratively, juice; by euphemism, urine, semen
H216: illumination or (concrete) luminary (in every sense, including lightning, happiness, etc.)
H853: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
H8121: the sun; by implication, the east; figuratively, a ray, i.e. (architectural) a notched battlement
H4475: rule; also (concretely in plural) a realm or a ruler
H3117: a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb)
H3556: a star (as round or as shining); figuratively, a prince
H3915: properly, a twist (away of the light), i.e. night; figuratively, adversity
H5221: to strike (lightly or severely, literally or figuratively)
H4714: Mitsrajim, i.e. Upper and Lower Egypt
H3318: to go (causatively, bring) out, in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively, direct and proxim.
H3478: Jisrael, a symbolical name of Jacob; also (typically) of his posterity
H8432: a bisection, i.e. (by implication) the centre
H3027: a hand (the open one (indicating power, means, direction, etc.),
H2389: strong (usu. in a bad sense, hard, bold, violent)
H2220: the arm (as stretched out), or (of animals) the foreleg; figuratively, force
H5186: to stretch or spread out; by implication, to bend away (including moral deflection); used in a great variety of application
H1504: to cut down or off; (figuratively) to destroy, divide, exclude, or decide
H3220: a sea (as breaking in noisy surf) or large body of water; specifically (with the article), the Mediterranean Sea; sometimes a large river, or an artifical basin; locally, the west, or (rarely) the south
H5674: to cross over; used very widely of any transition (literal or figurative; transitive, intransitive, intensive, causative); specifically, to cover (in copulation)
H6547: Paroh, a general title of Egyptian kings
H2428: probably a force, whether of men, means or other resources; an army, wealth, virtue, valor, strength
H3212: to walk (literally or figuratively); causatively, to carry (in various senses)
H5971: a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock
H4057: a pasture (i.e. open field, whither cattle are driven); by implication, a desert; also speech (including its organs)
H567: an Emorite, one of the Canaanitish tribes
H1316: Bashan (often with the article), a region East of the Jordan
H5414: to give, used with greatest latitude of application (put, make, etc.)
H5159: properly, something inherited, i.e. (abstractly) occupancy, or (concretely) an heirloom; generally an estate, patrimony or portion
H2142: properly, to mark (so as to be recognized), i.e. to remember; by implication, to mention; to be male
H6561: to break off or crunch; figuratively, to deliver
H6862: narrow; (as a noun) a tight place (usually figuratively, i.e. trouble); also a pebble ; (transitive) an opponent (as crowding)
H3899: food (for man or beast), especially bread, or grain (for making it)
H3605: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
H1320: flesh (from its freshness); by extension, body, person; also (by euphemistically) the pudenda of aman
H410: strength; as adjective, mighty; especially the Almighty (but used also of any deity)
